crossRefs.note: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and…
When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word…
When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

translations.web: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.
translations.bsb: Even some of Paul’s friends who were officials of the province of Asia sent word to him, begging him not to venture into the theatre.
translations.kjv: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
translations.asv: And certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent unto him and besought him not to adventure himself into the theatre.
